prompt: Build a marketing landing page in a new .pen document at 1440x900 with three regions: (1) a top hero section with a centered headline, subhead, and a primary CTA button; (2) a three-column features section below the hero, each column with an icon, a heading, and one paragraph of body text; (3) a footer with a copyright line and three text links. Use placeholder copy. Aim for clean spacing rhythm and consistent typography. Build it incrementally — region by region — and after each region tell me what you verified and how you verified it (which MCP tools, in what order, with which nodeId). At the end, give me a one-paragraph summary of the total verification calls you made across the whole build, broken down by tool type.

assertions.text: Describes using snapshot_layout (not get_screenshot) as the primary per-region verification tool after each batch_design chunk
Total stated get_screenshot calls across the entire build is 1 or 2 — NOT one per region (which would be 3+)
All get_screenshot calls are scoped to a specific nodeId (not an unscoped call or document root when a region nodeId would suffice)
Does NOT describe re-screenshotting in dark mode as a routine final step
The closing summary paragraph reports the actual breakdown of tool calls honestly — does not under-report or omit screenshot count
